subject: Data Engineering
title: Storage Tiers and Lifecycle
description: A short lesson to help you apply Storage Tiers and Lifecycle.

hook.text: Storing a terabyte in S3 Standard costs $23 per month. In Glacier Deep Archive? Just $1. Same data.

buildup.text: Cloud storage offers tiers: hot for frequent access, warm for occasional, cold for archives.

discovery.text: Lifecycle policies automatically move aging data to cheaper tiers based on access patterns.

twist.text: Cold storage is cheap to store but expensive to retrieve. Restoring from Glacier can take hours.

climax.text: Smart tiering balances cost and access speed, keeping hot data fast and cold data cheap.

punchline.text: Store hot data fast. Archive cold data cheap.

quiz.question: What is the trade-off with cold storage tiers?
options: Cheap to store but slow and expensive to retrieve
